content.text: The evidence is clear: this is a feature-flag toggle. The `monthly-spend-feature` flag flipped from off to on (33/167 mixed at 21:49, then fully on by 21:50), and immediately the account page began throwing `ZeroDivisionError` at `spend_summary.py:47`, correlating exactly with the error-rate spike in the metrics. No deployment or config change was recorded in this window, ruling out bad-deployment/config-induced-failure. Rollout is converged on one revision, ruling out in-flight-compatibility-break.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was toggled from off to on at 21:49, and the code path it enables (spend_summary.py) divides by zero when computing the monthly spend summary, causing account page requests to fail. Error rate in metrics jumps from ~1% baseline to 24%+ starting exactly at 21:49, matching the flag flip in the logs.
